[ASSISTANT_SAID] AutoX is an amazing sport, and California has plenty of excellent tracks to offer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended tracks in California include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Willow Springs International Raceway (Rosamond) - offers a variety of courses, including a dedicated AutoX track.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Buttonwillow Raceway Park (Buttonwillow) - known for high-speed corners and technical sections.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Thunderhill Raceway Park (Willows) - offers a range of configurations to test driving abilities.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Sonoma Raceway (Sonoma) - hosts several AutoX events throughout the year.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Marina Airport AutoX (Marina) - offers an airfield-based AutoX experience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Buttonwillow and Willow Springs have specific safety requirements and restrictions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Buttonwillow Raceway Park safety requirements include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Snell-rated helmet (SA2015 or newer) is mandatory.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Vehicle must meet SCCA safety requirements, including valid registration and proof of insurance.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Specific tire restrictions may apply.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. 103 dB sound limit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Willow Springs International Raceway safety requirements include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Snell-rated helmet (SA2015 or newer) is required.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Vehicle must meet SCCA safety requirements, including valid registration and proof of insurance.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. No specific tire restrictions, but high-speed corners may require robust tire compounds.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. 101 dB sound limit.
